newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kohl-Germany to pick up the pace of reforms.
newsitem.headline: Kohl-Germany to pick up the pace of reforms.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl said on Friday that Germany would step up the pace of pushing through planned reforms and that this would surely boost investor confidence.

"In the coming weeks we want to push forward the tax reform reforms and seek out discussions with opposition Social Democrats," Kohl told a news conference after discussions with an Italian delegation.
Kohl said Germany need to pick up the pace on pushing through these reforms, especially in light of Germany's record-high unemployment levels.
Decisions on German tax and pension reforms should be taken this year, and "this should provide a psychological boost" for investors.
